attempts.question: Does the Rankin scale imply the original bound for the same fixed H?
attempts.method: Divide the two expressions and compare powers of log x and log log x.
attempts.check: Keep k fixed and at least 2; retain every iterated logarithm.
attempts.outcome: The ratio is (log x)^(k-1)(log log log x)^k/(log log x)^(2k-1), which tends to infinity.
